method.metric: evals.metrics.summarise; equal-weight mean of the three target class field F1 scores for macro. Positive routing and empty negatives are separate. The organizer formula is unconfirmed.
method.dev_latency: Sum of measured primary reading, required RapidOCR pages, and route/extract call times divided by all 22 PDFs. Dev ablations replayed cached model responses through the product pipeline. Independent requests were collected in parallel; these stage sums estimate sequential batch time.
method.privacy: All dev predictions, raw responses, gold and error diagnostics were retained outside the repository. Shared response cache keyed by model and prompt included schema and generation settings. Only bounded page text was sent to the explicitly authorized development endpoint.
method.endpoint: Official DeepSeek Chat Completions, Pydantic AI 2.71.0 prompted JSON object mode. Flash alias deepseek-flash served V4.1-Flash-1017, thinking disabled; Pro served V4-Pro-0813. Pro was explicitly configured for low (24576 maximum completion tokens) for routing, high (32768) for extraction, 480-second deadline, one schema retry and zero transport retries.
method.local_runtime: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, unsloth Q4_K_M GGUF, llama.cpp b12608 (93cb37ea7), macOS arm64 Apple M1 16 GB. Weights SHA-256 3605803b982cb64aead44f6c1b2ae36e3acdb41d8e46c8a94c6533bc4c67e597.

dev_error_audit.method: Strict parent-paired field-report errors, not the official pooled multiset score. Audit uses expected values, cached ungrounded and grounded outputs and displayed source readings. The cause classes are mutually exclusive; ambiguous cases remain unresolved. A reference-equivalent proposal alone is insufficient evidence.

pro_dual_model_only.sources: Cached full primary/alternate first-three pages and their exact clipped excerpts; no further pages or OCR.

deepseek_flash.first_attempt_diagnostic: Batch failed before scoring; underlying exception was not retained.

test.protocol: Both profiles were selected and frozen using dev only. Each scored evaluation was the first to produce held-out aggregate metrics. After an initial CLI batch failure, the coordinator authorized per-document rules-only recovery and a retry without tuning any successful-path settings. Diagnostics were restricted to code stages, exception types and aggregate counters.

independent_flash_dev_repeat.method: Separate uncached call of the repository evaluator and the original CLI with aggregate diagnostic counters. The primary mode comparison shares identical model responses across modes.
